rationale: Required braking is itself the behaviour evaluated by T, not merely a control mechanism affecting a separate phenomenon. SG-1 establishes prevention of braking omissions, FR-7 requires collision-avoidance braking, and H-1 supplies the relevant collision-threatening situations. P describes the functional braking decision and execution without incorporating internal computation, sensing, communication, or mechanism-specific timing.
determining_elements: “Must decide and execute braking” identifies the functional response whose omission T addresses, without specifying an internal decision mechanism.
“Obstacles or other road users/obstacles relevant to collision avoidance” is supported by H-1's hazardous event and FR-7's braking obligation.
The declared scope covers road situations in which collision-avoidance braking may be required; FR-7 supports this scope beyond H-1's particular pedestrian-crossing example.
